name: YITAMOTOR Towing Mirrors Compatible with Chevy GMC 1999-2006 Silverado Sierra (2007 Classic Only), 2000-2006 Chevy Suburban 1500 2500 GMC Yukon XL Truck, Side Tow Mirror
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
Are you annoying about the blind spots in driving?
Are you worried about the accident when towing?
You need this MUST have extendable towing mirrors to KEEP YOUR DRIVING IN SAFETY.
Fitment
for 1999-2006 Chevy Silverado Pickup all models
for 1999-2006 GMC Sierra Pickup all models
for 2007 Chevy Silverado classic (old model)
for 2007 GMC Sierra classic (old model)
for 2000-2006 Chevy Tahoe (Excluding 2000 Z71)
for 2000-2006 Chevy Suburban
for 2002-2006 Chevy Avalanche
for 2000-2006 GMC Yukon /Yukon XL (Excluding 2000 Denali)
Professional installation would be highly recommended
Features
Fitment: compatible with 1999 - 2006 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500, 1999 - 2004 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 2500, 2001 - 2006 Chevy Silverado 2500 HD 3500 Tahoe & GMC Sierra 2500 HD 3500 Yukon Yukon XL Denali, 2000 - 2006 Chevy Suburban 1500 2500 & GMC Yukon XL 2500, 2002 - 2006 Chevy Avalanche 1500 2500, 2001 - 2003 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500 HD, 2005 - 2006 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500 HD, 2007 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra Classic
Package contents & dimensions: a pair of telescoping trailer tow mirrors, including driver side and passenger side; side mirror length is 18.5” (closed) and 21.26” (extended); side mirror size is 12.2”×7.68”
Functions: manually adjustable plane mirror & convex lens, manual telescoping & manual folding, the multifunctional side mirrors can strikingly enhance your driving experience
Clear view: the adjustable flat mirror & spotter mirror provides you with wider & clearer view of what's behind your vehicles, making it safer to drive, change lanes, park, etc
Note: please check if your vehicle has the same functions as that of towing mirrors, such as turn signal, otherwise some functions of towing mirrors will be disabled when the vehicle does not possess the corresponding functions(Professional installation would be highly recommended)

specifications.Material: Aluminum base; ABS plastic shell case
